name: 踢腿高度与柔韧度转换关系

map.踢腿高度与柔韧度转换关系在线工具: Convert kick height (distance from the ground) to flexibility indicators and vice versa.
map.📚 深度解析：踢腿高度与柔韧度比例换算: 📚 In-Depth: Kick Height & Flexibility Ratio Conversion
map.已知一个单位的数值，按固定系数换算到另一单位，用于训练记录对账。: Given a value in one unit, convert it to another by a fixed factor, for reconciling training records.
map.在厘米、英寸或身高: For converting centimeters, inches or body-height
map.把不同来源的训练数据统一到同一口径后再比较。: Bring training data from different sources onto a common basis before comparing.
map.填入数值、换算系数并选择\"从/到\"单位，工具按 结果 = 数值 × 系数 换: Enter the value and conversion factor and choose the "from/to" units; the tool converts by result = value × factor. For example, kick height 120 cm with factor 0.3937, from "centimeters" to "inches" → 47.2 in; if the height is 175 cm, kick height as a share of height = 120 ÷ 175 = 68.6%, and a factor of 0.00571 (1 ÷ 175) converts centimeters directly into a height fraction.
map.换算系数怎么定？: How is the conversion factor determined?
map.填两个单位之间的倍数。厘米→英寸填 0.3937，英寸→厘米填 2.54，厘米→: Enter the multiple between the two units. For cm → inches use 0.3937, for inches → cm use 2.54, and for cm → height fraction use 1 ÷ height (cm).
map.能自动识别我的训练项目吗？: Can it automatically recognize my training discipline?
map.不能。工具只做比例换算，不理解训练语义。请自行确认系数与单位方向，避免因填反系数: No. The tool only performs ratio conversion and does not understand training semantics. Confirm the factor and unit direction yourself to avoid a result that is off by an order of magnitude from a reversed factor.
map.踢腿高度与柔韧度转换关系。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全。: Kick Height & Flexibility Relationship. A free online tool that runs entirely in the browser, uploads no data, and protects your privacy.
map.柔韧指数：指数 = 踢腿高度 ÷ 身高 × 100（%）；踢腿点距头顶 = 身高: Flexibility index: index = kick height ÷ body height × 100 (%); kick point below the top of the head = body height − kick height (cm); when the index is not finite the grade is skipped. Validation: if kick height or body height is blank, the page prompts "Please fill in … before calculating" and outputs no value; body height ≤ 0 is rejected with a message instead of falling back to 0. Criteria: <60 stiff (regular stretching advised), <80 average, <100 good, ≥100 excellent (kick above head height); typical adults are 60–80, and a >10% difference between legs suggests asymmetry.
map.以踢腿高度与身高的比值衡量下肢柔韧度，数值越高柔韧性越好；为经验量化指标，仅供参: Measures lower-body flexibility by the ratio of kick height to body height; higher values mean better flexibility. An empirical quantitative index, for reference only.
